Hi Joshua,

Thanks for the application for the SWE, Inference Platform role — really enjoyed your background on streaming inference and kernel-level performance tuning. Would love to set a quick 20‑minute intro phone screen to get to know you and share more about the team.

I’m based in PST; to make this easy I pulled a few windows that should work across your timezone (I saw you’re in CDT on your profile):

- Tue Mar 9 — 9:00–11:00 CDT (UTC-5)
- Wed Mar 10 — 14:00–16:00 CDT (UTC-5)
- Thu Mar 11 — 18:30–19:30 CDT (UTC-5) (evening option)

If none of those work, send me 2–3 blocks that do and I’ll route a calendar invite. I’ve attached the role one‑pager and your resume I pulled from the application for convenience.

Proposed agenda (20m): 5m intros, 10m technical highlights / experience, 5m next steps.

Best,
Rachel
